games.name: [🎃] Alkedion PVP
games.desc:
ALKEDION PVP

Welcome to Alkedion PVP, a fast-paced third-person shooter where every fight is all about skill, movement, and teamwork. Challenge players from around the world, create your own clan, and prove yourself on the battlefield.

🎮 Game Modes

• Free For All (FFA)
• 1v1 Duels
• 2v2 - 5v5 Team Battles & Clan Wars

✨ Features

• Smooth and responsive third-person combat
• Roll, sprint, crouch, and outplay your opponents
• Collect unique weapon skins and effects
• Create or join a clan and compete with others
• Climb the leaderboards and earn rewards
• Frequent events, giveaways, and new content

🏆 Progress

Win matches, unlock rewards, improve your skills, and become one of the strongest players in Alkedion.

🖥️ PC Controls

• WASD – Move
• Mouse – Aim
• Left Click – Shoot
• Right Click – Aim / Zoom
• Space – Roll / Dodge
• Shift – Sprint
• C – Crouch
• R – Reload
• V – Open Inventory

games.name: [UPDATE 6.0] Demonfall
games.desc:
Demonfall is based on the popular series Demon Slayer.

Ascend the hill with the power of humanity on your shoulder, and fight for survival along with your comrades; or head down the ravine to lose ones humanity, and live as a demon with unholy powers.
Fight, explore, learn, grow, eat, all common necessities and virtues of one, despite your path, in this world, its the survival of the fittest.

[Controls]
R - Unsheathe Sword
Tab - Menu Toggle Tab --> Configuration = Reset
M - Meditate [Skill Tree]
H - Toggle Emotes
Sprint + M1 - Lunge
Block + M1 - Shoulder Bash
C - Rush
G - Breathe
Q - Dash
F - Block
J - Mark
U - Call Crow
